Missing pieces: Wizard's Staff, Roaming Throne, Plargg and Nassari, Wrecking Ball Arm, Swiftfoot Boots, Paradox Haze.

WIN PATH: Hit for 4 or more every turn, draw into upkeep engines and doublers, then multiply. Our clock is roughly turns 12-14. Theirs is turns 6-8 by the dossiers, but every board is nearly empty now.

THREAT ORDER: P4 > P1 > P2
- P4: Eminence tokens and the instant Vito combo. Attack them.
- P1: Giada is out and they hold 7 cards. Answer Angels as they grow.
- P2: slow self-mill. Leave them alone.

THIS TURN: Win now. Taigam, Sidisi's Hand pick priority: Fierce Guardianship, then Deflecting Swat (both free while we control Obeka), then Counterspell. Main phase 1: pay {2} (Fellwar Stone plus Otawara, Soaring City) for Ring of Evos Isle hexproof on Obeka, Splitter of Seconds. Then cast Court of Ire for {3}{R}{R}: R from Volcanic Island and Training Center, generic from Talisman of Creativity, Command Tower and Morphic Pool. We become the monarch. Keep Darkslick Shores for Swan Song. Attack P3 with Obeka only. P3's only creature, Lathliss, is tapped, so she connects for 23 and P3 (20 life) dies. That gives 23 extra upkeeps. Aim each Court of Ire trigger (7 damage): P1 first (6 triggers for 40 life), then P2 (8 triggers for 50).

TARGET: Game over this turn: 14 of the 23 Court triggers.

WIN PATH: Combat kills P3, then Court deals 98 against the 90 life P1 and P2 have left. Taigam's picks are not draws, so a short library cannot deck us.

THREAT ORDER: P1 > P2 > P3
- P1: Sauron board; burn first.
- P2: one open land (possible Swords to Plowshares); burn second.
- P3: dies to combat.

THREATS & ANSWERS: A counter on Court of Ire: Swan Song, or a picked Fierce Guardianship. Removal on Obeka before hexproof resolves: Fierce Guardianship or Deflecting Swat. Snuff Out can't target her (she's black).

HOLD: Swan Song (Darkslick Shores) until Court of Ire resolves. Don't cast Endless Evil, Sphere of Annihilation or Recantation. Taigam and Rekindling Phoenix stay home.

- Cast Wizard's Staff (2).
- Equip Psychic Paper first (2; type Wizard, harmless name).
- Equip Avarice Amulet (2), then Staff (Wizard {1}).
- Attack.
Missing pieces: Wrecking Ball Arm, Roaming Throne, Harmonic Prodigy.

WIN PATH: An unblockable 4-power Obeka with Staff gets 8 upkeeps per hit, plus Paradox Haze's upkeep before combat. They become draws and Vault mana. Commander damage needs 6 hits at 4 power, fewer with Wrecking Ball Arm. We're at 31; P1's flying clock is about 7 and growing.

THREAT ORDER: P4 > P1 > P2
- P4: Exquisite Blood is out, so Vito, Sanguine Bond or Bloodthirsty Conqueror wins on the spot. Counter it.
- P1: Giada plus a growing Herald of War and 6 cards; the main board clock. Attack them once Obeka connects.
- P2: Teval and Six are slower. Leave them alone.

THREATS & ANSWERS: Mana Drain on P4's combo piece; its mana arrives in our next main phase and funds Obeka. Counterspell is for the second combo piece, Akroma's Will, or a wipe once Obeka is down. Don't chump-block.

HOLD: {U}{U} up every opponent turn. Keep Chronozoa in hand unless fliers threaten lethal.

REPLAN IF:
- P4 resolves a combo piece: counter the second piece, or find enchantment removal with tutors.
- Paradox Haze is countered: still keep {U}{U} open.
- P1 swings wide or we drop below 15: cast Chronozoa as a flying blocker.

memo:
THIS TURN: Play Baxter Building as the land and keep Island for next turn. Cast nothing before combat. Attack P3 with Obeka, Splitter of Seconds (3/6, menace; no creatures on any board). Keep Sol Ring untapped. If anything targets Obeka during combat, pay {2} for Ring of Evos Isle hexproof in response. A hit gives 3 extra upkeeps after combat, and the Ring adds a counter in each, so she becomes 6/9. Leave all 5 mana open through opponents' turns. At P3's end step, if we spent nothing, activate Baxter Building ({4}, {T}: draw a card; Obeka gives us the toughness-4 creature).

TARGET: Obeka growing every upkeep, plus Court of Ire, Virtue of Persistence, Rhystic Study or Phyrexian Arena, and Thassa, God of the Sea or Aqueous Form for evasion. Play Island next turn.

WIN PATH: Commander damage on P3: 3 this turn, 7 next turn (10 total), then 15 the turn after (25, dead). That is three swings including this one. After that Obeka one-shots anyone.

THREAT ORDER: P3 > P1 > P2. P3: fastest ramp, Crux of Fate, hasty Dragons, few counters; attack them every turn. P1: Feed the Swarm, Blasphemous Act, Sauron coming; watch them. P2: open mana and heavy spot removal but slow; leave them alone.

THREATS & ANSWERS: Neither side has lethal. Answer targeted removal (Swords to Plowshares, Feed the Swarm, Dismember) with Ring hexproof {2}. Snuff Out can't target Obeka because she's black. Answer a wipe or edict with Teferi's Time Twist (1U) on Obeka. She returns at the next end step as a new object: one +1/+1 counter, commander damage reset, Ring unattached (re-equip for {1}). Cycle Decree of Pain ({3}{B}{B}) against Orc Armies or Orcish Bowmasters.

HOLD: On opponents' turns keep Sol Ring for hexproof, plus a blue land and one more land for Teferi's Time Twist. Use Baxter Building's draw only at P3's end step.

REPLAN IF: Obeka is removed: recast her for 6 and restart the clock on P3. Sauron or Terror of the Peaks resolves: plan a sweep. P3 dies: switch attacks to P1.

This taps us out, which is acceptable: P1 shows 8 power against our 38. No attack.

TARGET: Next turn, play Baxter Building. Cast Legacy's Allure (UU from Underground Sea and Volcanic Island) before combat, then attack with Obeka. Baxter Building's draw ability works with Obeka out (toughness 5). Missing pieces: Court of Ire, Virtue of Persistence, Sol Ring or Arcane Signet, Phyrexian Arena.

WIN PATH: Each Obeka hit gives extra upkeeps that stack Torch Song and Legacy's Allure counters. Steal Baneslayer Angel with Legacy's Allure at 6 counters, burn with Torch Song, and add Court of Ire later. Our clock is slower than P1's, so we play control.

THREAT ORDER: P1 > P4 > P2
- P1: 8 flying power with Baneslayer Angel and Giada. Steal or remove both.
- P4: tokens and a drain combo. Answer Vito or Exquisite Blood on sight.
- P2: graveyard value, slower. Leave them alone for now.

THREATS & ANSWERS:
- Baneslayer Angel: Legacy's Allure at 6 counters, Torch Song at 6, or Drown in the Loch once P1's graveyard has 5 or more cards.
- Giada: Drown in the Loch once P1's graveyard has 2 or more cards.
- Vito or Exquisite Blood: Torch Song or Drown in the Loch.
- Obeka cannot block fliers (Baneslayer Angel, Giada, Teval). It may block Six.
- Never chump-block into P4.
- Attack with Obeka (menace) only at a player whose two untapped blockers deal 4 or less combined. P4 qualifies now.

HOLD: Drown in the Loch, Aetherize and Frenzied Fugue. Keep Baxter Building for next turn's land drop.

- Obeka is removed: recast it for 6.
- P1's graveyard reaches 2 or more cards: Drown in the Loch on Giada.
- An alpha strike threatens 25 or more damage: hold Aetherize (4 mana including U).

TARGET: Obeka, Splitter of Seconds connecting every turn with Galvanoth or Cast Through Time out and counter mana up. Missing: Galvanoth, Cast Through Time, Sword of Wealth and Power, Counterspell, Fiery Confluence. If Demonic Tutor is drawn, fetch Galvanoth.

WIN PATH: Obeka, Splitter of Seconds deals 2 a turn into doubled upkeep spells, then Fiery Confluence or Breath of Malfegor cast twice. That takes about 5-6 turns. No opponent has a clock now.

THREAT ORDER: P1 > P4 > P2. P1 has 5 cards and Angel cost cuts; attack them and kill a recast Giada, Font of Hope on sight. P4's eminence makes tokens without Edgar Markov, and the Vito combo can win instantly; remove Vito, Exquisite Blood and drainers. P2 has 6 cards and a filling graveyard; leave them alone and counter Living Death.

THREATS & ANSWERS: Recast Giada, Font of Hope: Lightning Bolt or Staggershock. Vito or Exquisite Blood: Chaos Warp or Bedevil. Living Death: Counterspell, Arcane Denial or Swan Song. A wide rebuild: Damnation. Never chump-block against P4.

HOLD: Keep Damnation for a real rebuild of 3+ creatures; it costs us Obeka, Splitter of Seconds plus tax. Hold drawn counters for Living Death or Vito.

REPLAN IF: Obeka, Splitter of Seconds is removed (recast at {1}{U}{B}{R}+2 only if nothing else is needed). Living Death resolves. Vito or Exquisite Blood lands. P1 lands 2+ Angels.

THIS TURN: Play Access Tunnel; it enters untapped. Cast Obeka, Splitter of Seconds for 6 including tax:
- R from Volcanic Island, U from Morphic Pool, B from Bojuka Bog.
- Generic from Arcane Signet, Fellwar Stone and Access Tunnel.
- Leave Talisman of Creativity untapped; it has no use.

Obeka enters tapped under Authority of the Consuls. Cast nothing else: we hold no instants.

TARGET: Next turn we have 7 mana, or 8 with a land drop.
- Cast Lizard Blades (2). It enters tapped, which doesn't matter. Reconfigure it onto Obeka (2).
- Precombat, cast Fantastic Elasticity (3) to bounce Lathliss, Dragon Queen or a newer big threat. With no worthy target, choose its graveyard mode and return Delayed Blast Fireball instead.
- Attack P2 if Y'shtola is still their only creature: one creature can't block menace.
- Double strike gives 4 extra upkeeps. In the first, Elasticity rebounds: return Delayed Blast Fireball to hand.
- Missing pieces: Cast Through Time, Galvanoth, Sol Ring, Rogue's Passage.

WIN PATH: Double-strike Obeka, with World at War cast precombat for extra combats, plus the Fireball recursion: foretell it (2) and cast it later from exile for 5 to each opponent and their creatures. We close around turns 24-26; P3 is faster.

THREAT ORDER: P3 > P1 > P2.
- P3: Lathliss (6/6 flyer) and a ramped hand of 6; every nontoken Dragon they cast adds a 5/5 token. Bounce Lathliss.
- P1: needs a 6th land for Sauron, and each of our spells will amass. Don't target through his ward.
- P2: slow drain. Attack them only for the extra upkeeps.

THREATS & ANSWERS:
- Lathliss: Fantastic Elasticity.
- Dragon tokens, Nazgûl, Orcish Siegemaster: the foretold Fireball.
- Sauron: we have no answer yet. Dig for Toxic Deluge, Damnation or Blasphemous Act, which don't target. Chaos Warp targets, so his ward would make us sacrifice Obeka.

HOLD: Thassa, God of the Sea and World at War until Obeka has double strike and we have spare mana. Never attack where two untapped creatures can double-block, especially with deathtouch Nazgûl.

REPLAN IF:
- Obeka is removed or countered: cast Theater of Horrors and Thassa next turn.
- P2 gains a second creature: attack whoever has at most one untapped creature.
- Terror of the Peaks resolves: bounce it with Elasticity.

- Damnation drawn: cast Damnation ({2}{B}{B}). With a 10th land, also cast Recurring Insight on P4; otherwise cast Archmage Emeritus.
- Aetherize ({3}{U}), Evacuation or Aetherspouts ({3}{U}{U}) drawn: keep 5 open and cast it on P1's declare-attackers step. Cast Archmage Emeritus with the other 4.
- Otherwise: cast Recurring Insight ({4}{U}{U}) on P4 (3 cards). With the 3 left, take the first available:
  - Blasphemous Act: costs {R} with 9 creatures out. Cast it now.
  - Demonic Tutor ({1}{B}): fetch Blasphemous Act and cast it for {R}.
  - Brainstorm ({U}): then re-check this list.
  - Counterspell ({U}{U}), Swan Song ({U}) or Arcane Denial ({1}{U}): hold for P4.

TARGET: P1's board wiped. Then Archmage Emeritus, Storm-Kiln Artist, and Obeka, Splitter of Seconds (12 mana) with Aether Tunnel, Cast Through Time and Fiery Confluence.

WIN PATH: Unblockable Obeka plus doubled Fiery Confluence, 4+ turns away. Survive first.

THREAT ORDER: P1 > P4
- P1: 63 flying power, lethal on us at 13 next combat; hand empty. Wipe it.
- P4: Sanguine Bond is out; Exquisite Blood or Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose wins at once. Counter or remove those.

THREATS & ANSWERS:
- P1's attack: Blasphemous Act, Damnation, Aetherize, Evacuation, Aetherspouts. Sephara is gone, so destroy wipes work.
- Toxic Deluge needs X=12 for Archangel of Thune and leaves us at 1. Use it only if nothing else exists.
- Exquisite Blood: Swan Song, Counterspell, Arcane Denial, or Fierce Guardianship ({2}{U} without Obeka out).
- Vito: Lightning Bolt or Terminate.
- Sanguine Bond: Chaos Warp.

HOLD: Keep Storm-Kiln Artist and Aether Tunnel in hand until P1 is answered. Never tap below a held wipe's cost.

REPLAN IF: Giada, Font of Hope rebuilds P1. P4 casts Exquisite Blood or Vito. If we find no answer, hold a counter for P4.

Main 1: cast Ring of Evos Isle ({2}) and equip it to Obeka, Splitter of Seconds ({1}), leaving 8. Attack with Obeka alone at P1. Brotherhood Regalia makes her unblockable, so P1 goes to 9 and we get 2 extra upkeeps: Theater of Horrors exiles 2 cards, and Obeka gets 2 counters (4/7). Cards exiled with Theater are castable only during our turn, so use any answer now, in this priority:
1. Army answer: Evacuation (the token vanishes), Chaos Warp or Bedevil on the Orc Army Token, Damnation or Toxic Deluge in Main 2.
2. Otherwise kill Warg Rider (4/3, needs 3 damage): Lightning Bolt, Terminate, Feed the Swarm, Fire Covenant, Mizzium Mortars. Staggershock, Electrolyze and Kolaghan's Command don't kill it.

Main 2: cast Fellwar Stone, then put spare mana into Theater pings ({3}{R}) at P1.

TARGET: The Army or Warg Rider gone, and Obeka growing on Ring of Evos Isle. Missing: Evacuation, Chaos Warp, Damnation, Aetherize.

WIN PATH: P1 is the last opponent. Next turn Obeka hits for 5+, plus pings and any burn (Breath of Malfegor, Fiery-style), to finish P1. P1 kills us next combat (Army about 26, menace) unless it is answered.

THREAT ORDER: P1 only. The menace Army can't be blocked under Silent Arbiter, so answer it or Warg Rider this turn.

THREATS & ANSWERS: Orc Army Token: the list above. Warg Rider: removal dealing 3 or more. Sauron has ward (sacrifice a legendary), so never target him. Amass growth matters less than survival.

HOLD: Keep Silent Arbiter. Keep an instant drawn from hand (Aetherize, Evacuation) plus its mana for P1's attack. Keep {2} for Ring of Evos Isle's hexproof if P1 targets Obeka.

REPLAN IF: Warg Rider dies: chump the Army with Storm-Kiln Artist, then Ojer Pakpatiq; take Sauron's 7. Burn puts P1 within reach: count and go.

- P1: Palantír of Orthanc engine, and Sauron is castable soon. Bedevil the Palantír if no Dragon needs it.
- P2: slow control, 7 cards. Leave them alone; Snuff Out can't hit black Obeka.

Badlands is a Mountain and enters untapped. Main phase 1: cast Obeka, Splitter of Seconds for 6 (4 plus tax 2). Pay with Swamp (B), Steam Vents (U), Training Center (R), plus Xander's Lounge, Access Tunnel and Badlands. This taps us out, and there is no attack this turn. At P1's end step, Palantír of Orthanc goes to 3 counters. If we are its target, let it mill while we're at 25+ life; otherwise let P1 draw.

TARGET: Obeka connecting every turn for 2 extra upkeeps, Theater of Horrors exiling 3 cards a turn, and Storm-Kiln Artist out. Missing: Cast Through Time, Galvanoth, Aqueous Form, Counterspell.

WIN PATH: Grind card advantage from Obeka hits. Then cast Fiery Confluence (6 to each opponent) doubled under Cast Through Time, plus Breath of Malfegor. That is 4+ turns away; P3 is faster.

THREAT ORDER: P3 > P1 > P2
- P3: ramp, 4 cards, cheap hasty Dragons. Attack P3 with Obeka next turn and kill their first Dragon.
- P1: Palantír of Orthanc engine, and Sauron is castable soon. Bedevil the Palantír if no Dragon needs it.
- P2: slow control, 7 cards. Leave them alone; Snuff Out can't hit black Obeka.

THREATS & ANSWERS: Bedevil (Swamp, Xander's Lounge or Badlands for BB, plus R) goes to Terror of the Peaks or Scourge of Valkas first (targeting Terror costs 3 life). Otherwise it goes to Palantír of Orthanc. Never target Sauron (his ward makes us sacrifice a legendary); he needs a wipe. Next turn, if a blocker appears, Access Tunnel ({3},{T}) makes Obeka (power 2) unblockable.

HOLD: Bedevil, Fiery Confluence (save it for doubling, not artifact removal) and Silent Arbiter.

REPLAN IF:
- Obeka is countered or removed: her next cast costs 8. Cast Storm-Kiln Artist next turn instead.
- A flying or hasty Dragon lands: Bedevil it on our turn.
- Sauron lands: cast fewer spells and save Silent Arbiter for Army swarms.

memo:
THIS TURN: 1. In upkeep, cast the Fantastic Elasticity rebound for free in graveyard mode and return Delayed Blast Fireball to hand. The cast amasses P1 an Army. 2. In main phase 1, foretell Delayed Blast Fireball for {2} with Access Tunnel and Bojuka Bog. 3. Cast nothing else. Keep 6 up: Volcanic Island, Morphic Pool, Shipwreck Marsh, Arcane Signet, Talisman of Creativity, Fellwar Stone. Red comes from Volcanic Island, Arcane Signet and Fellwar Stone. 4. A foretold card can't be cast the turn it's foretold. On P1's turn, ideally at their beginning of combat after they spend mana, cast Delayed Blast Fireball from exile for {4}{R}{R}. It deals 5 to each opponent and their creatures. That kills P3, Atarka, Nazgûl, Orcish Siegemaster, Y'shtola and the Orc Army. Its cast amasses first, but the Army is only 2/2. Latest window: P3's upkeep.

TARGET: P3 dead and boards cleared. Next turn: Obeka, Splitter of Seconds ({4} plus {2} tax = 6) and Lizard Blades (2). Turn after: reconfigure Lizard Blades onto Obeka ({2}), Thassa, God of the Sea ({3}) and Thassa's unblockable ({1}{U}). Missing: Cast Through Time, Galvanoth, Demonic Tutor.

WIN PATH: Unblockable double-strike Obeka, with World at War cast precombat so it rebounds in her extra upkeep. About 3–4 turns.

THREAT ORDER: P3 > P1 > P2.
- P3: 5 life, Atarka double strike, lethal pressure. Kill them with the Fireball.
- P1: Sauron, wheels, every spell amasses. Sweep, never target Sauron.
- P2: 49 life, slow drain. Leave them alone.

THREATS & ANSWERS: The Fireball answers Atarka and P1's small creatures. Sauron (7/6) and Miirym (6/6) survive it, so use Toxic Deluge or Damnation later. Enduring Tenacity returns as an enchantment and drains on P2's lifegain. Don't feed P1 cheap spells.

HOLD: All 6 for the Fireball. Hold World at War, Thassa, God of the Sea, Theater of Horrors and Lizard Blades.

REPLAN IF:
- Fireball is countered: rebuild with Obeka next turn.
- P3 dies first: cast the Fireball at P2's end step.
- P3 makes an instant-speed hasty threat: fire immediately.

memo:
THIS TURN: 1) Let the stack resolve. P2's Emet-Selch of the Third Seat recasts Vindicate. It cannot target Obeka, Splitter of Seconds, because the Sword gives protection from sorceries. It will likely hit Panoptic Mirror or Sword of Wealth and Power. We have no response, so pass. 2) Both Obeka triggers give 8 extra upkeeps. Both Sword of Wealth and Power triggers copy our next instant or sorcery. 3) Extra upkeep 1: Panoptic Mirror trigger. Copy the imprinted Fiery Confluence and cast it free, choosing "2 damage to each opponent" ×3. Both Sword copies add 6 each, so 18 to each opponent: P1 and P3 die. P2 drops 35→17. 4) Extra upkeeps 2-4: Mirror Fiery Confluence, 6 each time, kills P2. Cast nothing from hand before the Mirror copy, so the Sword copies land on it.

TARGET: all opponents dead this turn.

WIN PATH: the Mirror's Fiery Confluence, copied twice by the Sword, then once per upkeep. The 8 upkeeps are double what we need.

THREAT ORDER: P3 > P1 > P2
- P3: 10/10 flyer at 10 life. Burn them first.
- P1: at 8 with Witch-king of Angmar. Burn them, never attack them.
- P2: at 35 with Propaganda. Burn them last.

THREATS & ANSWERS: Vindicate on the Mirror is the only risk; we have nothing to stop it. Aetherize is earmarked for an Ur-Dragon or Orc attack.

HOLD: Aetherize with 4 mana (Castle Vantress, Underground Sea, Watery Grave, Access Tunnel) for opponents' turns. Hold Damnation, because it kills Obeka too. Don't spend the Treasure in the upkeeps unless it wins.

REPLAN IF:
- The Mirror is destroyed: no kill this turn. Main 2: cast Archmage Emeritus only if 4 mana is left after keeping Aetherize up, otherwise pass. Use Aetherize on P3's Ur-Dragon attack.
- The Mirror's imprint is not Fiery Confluence: copy it anyway, aim damage at P3, then P1.
- P2 survives at 8 upkeeps: next turn, attack P3's remaining players again with the same line.

memo:
THIS TURN: Play Island and keep Blood Crypt. Real mana is 10 (9 lands plus the Treasure Token), 11 with the Island; Ojer Pakpatiq and Storm-Kiln Artist make none. Main 1: cast Ring of Evos Isle ({2}) and equip it to Obeka, Splitter of Seconds ({1}), leaving 8. Attack with Obeka alone at P1. Brotherhood Regalia makes her unblockable, so P1 goes to 9 and we get 2 extra upkeeps: Theater of Horrors exiles 2 cards, and Obeka gets 2 counters (4/7). Cards exiled with Theater are castable only during our turn, so use any answer now, in this priority:
1. Army answer: Evacuation (the token vanishes), Chaos Warp or Bedevil on the Orc Army Token, Damnation or Toxic Deluge in Main 2.
2. Otherwise kill Warg Rider (4/3, needs 3 damage): Lightning Bolt, Terminate, Feed the Swarm, Fire Covenant, Mizzium Mortars. Staggershock, Electrolyze and Kolaghan's Command don't kill it.

Main 2: cast Fellwar Stone, then put spare mana into Theater pings ({3}{R}) at P1.

TARGET: The Army or Warg Rider gone, and Obeka growing on Ring of Evos Isle. Missing: Evacuation, Chaos Warp, Damnation, Aetherize.

WIN PATH: P1 is the last opponent. Next turn Obeka hits for 5+, plus pings and any burn (Breath of Malfegor, Fiery-style), to finish P1. P1 kills us next combat (Army about 26, menace) unless it is answered.

THREAT ORDER: P1 only. The menace Army can't be blocked under Silent Arbiter, so answer it or Warg Rider this turn.

THREATS & ANSWERS: Orc Army Token: the list above. Warg Rider: removal dealing 3 or more. Sauron has ward (sacrifice a legendary), so never target him. Amass growth matters less than survival.

HOLD: Keep Silent Arbiter. Keep an instant drawn from hand (Aetherize, Evacuation) plus its mana for P1's attack. Keep {2} for Ring of Evos Isle's hexproof if P1 targets Obeka.

REPLAN IF: Warg Rider dies: chump the Army with Storm-Kiln Artist, then Ojer Pakpatiq; take Sauron's 7. Burn puts P1 within reach: count and go.

THIS TURN: Decline every Smothering Tithe payment. Recurring Insight draws 0 because P1 has no hand; it is only a 6-mana Archmage Emeritus draw. Main phase 1: cast Delayed Blast Fireball ({1}{R}{R}) to draw 1 card. That leaves 6 mana. Play any land drawn, then take the first line that fits:
- Aetherspouts ({3}{U}{U}), Evacuation ({3}{U}{U}) or Aetherize ({3}{U}): hold its mana and cast it in P1's declare-attackers step.
- Blasphemous Act (costs {R} with 8+ creatures out) plus Terminate ({B}{R}), Chaos Warp ({2}{R}), Bedevil ({B}{B}{R}) or Feed the Swarm ({1}{B}, we lose 7 life): remove Sephara, Sky's Blade first, then cast the wipe. Damnation ({2}{B}{B}) works the same way if the mana fits.
- Demonic Tutor ({1}{B}): with Blasphemous Act in hand, fetch Terminate. Otherwise fetch Aetherspouts if 7+ mana is left, else Aetherize.
- Brainstorm ({U}): cast it, then re-check this list.
- Nothing found: cast Recurring Insight targeting P1 for the Emeritus card, then re-check.

TARGET: Survive P1's attack with their board bounced, tucked or wiped. Then Obeka, Splitter of Seconds (12 mana) with Aether Tunnel and Storm-Kiln Artist.

WIN PATH: P1 at 34 is unreachable now. Long term: unblockable Obeka plus doubled Fiery Confluence. P1 kills us next combat, so survival is the whole plan.

THREAT ORDER: P1 only (sole opponent). P1 has 89 flying power, Archangel of Thune lifelink growth, and Sephara making its other flyers indestructible. Stop the attack.

THREATS & ANSWERS: Sephara: Terminate, Chaos Warp, Bedevil, Feed the Swarm. Attackers: Aetherspouts > Evacuation > Aetherize. Don't cast Toxic Deluge; it misses Thune and Sephara. Delayed Blast Fireball kills nothing. Never gain life for P1.

HOLD: Keep Storm-Kiln Artist and Aether Tunnel in hand. Authority of the Consuls gives P1 life (and Thune counters) for each creature we cast. Never tap below a found answer's cost.

REPLAN IF: P1 gets Flawless Maneuver or Teferi's Protection. Sephara leaves the battlefield; then Damnation or Blasphemous Act alone clears the board.

memo:
THIS TURN: Play Marsh Flats as our land drop and crack it right away (pay 1 life) for Underground Sea. Underground Sea is an Island Swamp, makes {U} or {B} and enters untapped. Cracking now shuffles the library before our scry. Cast nothing at sorcery speed: no board has a target worth Fantastic Elasticity or Damnation. At P3's end step, tap Island ({U}), Underground Sea ({U}) and Sol Ring ({C}{C}) to pay {2}{U}{U}, then tap Castle Vantress itself to scry 2. Keep cards that build colour or make Obeka connect. If something must be answered sooner, skip the scry.

TARGET: Next turn, play Sulfur Falls (it enters untapped because we control an Island). Cast Obeka, Splitter of Seconds by tapping Underground Sea for {B}, Sulfur Falls for {R}, Island for {U} and Sol Ring for {1}. That leaves Castle Vantress ({U}) and one {C} floating from Sol Ring. Still missing: a second black source for Damnation (Watery Grave, Blood Crypt, Swamp, Talisman of Dominance), Cast Through Time, and evasion (Aqueous Form, Brotherhood Regalia).

WIN PATH: Obeka connects. Fantastic Elasticity, cast in main phase 1, rebounds that same turn. Access Tunnel ({3},{T}) makes Obeka (power 2) unblockable. Close around turns 13–16 with Fiery Confluence under Cast Through Time, or with Court of Ire. P1 and P3 are faster.

THREAT ORDER: P3 > P1 > P2.
- P3: 7 cards, ramping into hasty Dragons; Damnation is for its board.
- P1: its Talisman brings Sauron closer. Once he lands, cast fewer, bigger spells and never target him.
- P2: slow removal control; leave it alone. Expect Dismember on Obeka; Snuff Out can't target her because she is black.

THREATS & ANSWERS:
- Damnation answers a Dragon board, Sauron's Army, or Sauron himself. It doesn't target, so his ward doesn't apply.
- Fantastic Elasticity (a sorcery, so our turn only) answers Miirym (pay ward {2}), Terror of the Peaks (targeting it costs 3 life) or Call of the Ring.

HOLD: Damnation until it kills two or more real threats. Fantastic Elasticity for an Obeka turn or a must-answer permanent. Play Access Tunnel late, but keep it on the battlefield as Obeka's evasion.

REPLAN IF:
- Obeka is removed twice: switch to draw-go and lean on Damnation.
- P3 lands Terror of the Peaks or Scourge of Valkas: cast Fantastic Elasticity on it on our next turn.
- Sauron resolves: stop casting cheap spells.

memo:
THIS TURN: It is our end step and we hold no instants. Cast nothing and pass. Our real mana is 7 lands; Ojer Pakpatiq, Deepest Epoch is a creature, not a mana source. On opponents' turns, cast nothing, because every spell we cast grows P1's Orc Army.
- At P1's end step, Palantír of Orthanc has 5 counters. Always let P1 draw; never allow the mill.
- Block P3's single attacker with Ojer Pakpatiq (flying) if it is The Ur-Dragon or Dragonlord Dromoka. Ojer comes back as a land.
- Do not block P1's Army; menace makes it unblockable here.

TARGET: Remove P1's Orc Army and Sauron with a wipe from Theater of Horrors or spot removal. Exile P1's graveyard. Missing: Blasphemous Act, Damnation, Toxic Deluge, Evacuation, Cast Through Time.

WIN PATH: Survive first. Next turn, follow the previous plan: Obeka, Splitter of Seconds attacks P1 alone, unblockable through Brotherhood Regalia. In main phase 2, cast a wipe or removal from Theater exile. Fiery Confluence for 6 to each opponent comes later; it is not lethal yet. This is a slow clock.

THREAT ORDER: P1 > P3
- P1: the Army reaches 14 next combat (Warg Rider +2, March from the Black Gate +1). That is under our 16 life only if we cast zero spells. Wipe it on our turn and never target Sauron (ward).
- P3: Silent Arbiter allows only one attacker, so the threat is at most 10 flying. Chump with Ojer.

THREATS & ANSWERS: Army: a wipe or removal from Theater exile next turn. The Ur-Dragon: chump with Ojer Pakpatiq. Feed Sauron nothing.

HOLD: Fiery Confluence, Storm-Kiln Artist and Fellwar Stone until a wipe resolves. Keep Ojer untapped as a blocker.

REPLAN IF:
- Silent Arbiter dies (for example to Mount Doom): chump the Army with Ojer, and wipe at the first chance.
- We drop below the Army's power: chump with Silent Arbiter or Ojer.
